{"metadata":{"description":"Find DSH plugins inside the agent — live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search, star-ranked / 会话内搜索发现 DSH 插件","id":"gh:1333689922","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-find-plugin","slug":"awesome-dsh-plugin/dsh-find-plugin","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Find DSH plugins inside the agent — live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search, star-ranked / 会话内搜索发现 DSH 插"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ind DSH plugins inside the agent — live GitHub dsh-plugin topic search, star-ranked / 会话内搜索发现 DSH 插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-find-plugin [](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**A plugin that finds plugins** — think `/find-skills` from skills.sh, for DSH."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Tell your agent what you want ("notify me on WeChat when a task finishes"),
and it searches the DSH "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"plugin ecosystem on GitHub for you — top results by
stars, each with a one-line description and an i"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"m on GitHub for you — top results by
stars, each with a one-line description and an install command."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Restart `dsh web` after installing, then just talk to the agent — it calls
`find_dsh_plugin` on its "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"own whenever plugin discovery helps:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- "What terminal TUI plugins are there?"
- "I want to get a WeChat notification when a task finishes"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" — any plugin for that?"
- "Find me something for reviewing git diffs inside DSH.""},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Each result comes back with stars, a description, the repo link, and a
ready-to-run `dsh plugin add`"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" command — ask the agent to install one and
it can run the command for you."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"- Live GitHub repository search scoped to the official `dsh-plugin` topic,
re-ranked by stars (5-min"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"ute per-query cache).
- When a result is also listed on
awesome-dsh-plugin, its hand-written
bilingu"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"al description from `plugins.json` replaces the GitHub one (the
`lang` parameter picks the language)"},{"id":"p13s4","text":" — ranking is untouched.
- Every result comes with a ready-to-run `dsh plugin add` command. Plugins
"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"are third-party code — review the source and pin a commit."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### Rate limits and offline fallback"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"GitHub's **search** API allows only 10 requests/minute per public IP when
unauthenticated, and that "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"quota is shared by every host behind the same egress
IP (carrier CGNAT, corporate NAT, …), so a sear"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"ch can fail with `HTTP 403` for
reasons outside your control. The plugin therefore:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- uses the **`GITHUB_TOKEN` DSH credential** when one is configured (30
req/min, account-scoped, imm"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"une to shared-IP exhaustion). Optional — without
it the tool still works, just closer to the anonymo"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"us limit;
- retries a rate-limited (403/429) or failed request once, then degrades
instead of failin"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"g: it falls back to **keyword matches from the curated
list** and says so in the result note;
- cach"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"es the curated list on disk (`$DSH_HOME/cache/dsh-find-plugin/`) and
revalidates it with `If-None-Ma"},{"id":"p16s6","text":"tch` / `If-Modified-Since`, so restarts and
offline runs use the full ~3400-entry list instead of th"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"e small bundled
snapshot.
- says *why* a request failed. Node reports every transport failure as a b"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"are
`fetch failed` and hides the useful part in `cause`, so the plugin surfaces
the chain (`fetch fa"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"iled ← certificate has expired (CERT_HAS_EXPIRED)`) and
names the one trap that otherwise looks like"},{"id":"p16s10","text":" a plugin bug: a system proxy or
VPN accelerator, which Node's `fetch` ignores unless DSH itself was"},{"id":"p16s11","text":" started
with `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` (or `--use-env-proxy`). A browser has no such
rule — which is w"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"hy GitHub opens fine and this still fails."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"DSH plugin APIs are prerelease-versioned, and node-semver only lets a
prerelease satisfy a range tha"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"t carries a prerelease on the *same*
major.minor.patch — so a peer range pinned to one host line sil"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"ently stops
matching the next one. The declared `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` range therefore
names every"},{"id":"p18s4","text":" shipped line through `0.1.7`, and `npm run check:peers` (run in CI)
resolves the current `latest`/`"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"next` host lines from the registry and fails the
day a new one is not covered."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"MIT © awesome-dsh-plugin"}],"truncated":false}
